Algorithm 1 The training procedure of the Supervised Training stage for the proposed DistillCvT.
Require: Mini batch b from the training dataset \(D\), embedding backbone \(f_{\theta}\), squared Euclidean distance, \(d(\cdot,\cdot)\), learning rate \(\alpha\), standard data augmentation \(\mathcal{A}\)
randomly initialize \(\theta\)
for \(b \sim D\) do
    apply standard data augmentation:
    \(\tilde{b} \leftarrow \{(\mathcal{A}(x),y) \mid (x,y) \in b\}\)
    \(\{S_k\}_{k=1}^N, Q \leftarrow \tilde{b}\)
    compute few-shot loss:
    \(\mathcal{L}_{\text{FSL}} \leftarrow 0\)
    \(c_k \leftarrow \frac{1}{|S_k|} \sum_{(x_i,y_i) \in S_k} f_\theta(x_i)\)
    for each \((x_i, y_i) \in \mathcal{Q}\) do
        \(\mathcal{L}_{\text{FSL}} \leftarrow \mathcal{L}_{\text{FSL}} + \ell(x_i, y_i)\)
    end for
    \(\mathcal{L}_{\text{FSL}} \leftarrow \frac{1}{|\mathcal{Q}|} \mathcal{L}_{\text{FSL}}\)
    \(\theta \leftarrow \theta - \alpha \nabla_\theta \mathcal{L}_{\text{FSL}}\)
end for
return Trained \(f_{\theta}\) as the teacher model

Algorithm 2 The training procedure of the Self-Supervised Distillation stage for the proposed DistillCvT
Require: The training dataset \(D\), jigsaw puzzle \(\mathcal{P}(.,.)\), granularity of patches \(n\), embedding backbone \(f_{\theta_s}\), squared Euclidean distance \(d(\cdot,\cdot)\), learning rate \(\alpha\), temperature \(\tau\), standard data augmentation \(\mathcal{A}\)
receive \(\theta\) from Supervised Training stage as teacher model
initialize student model \(\theta_s\)
for \(b \sim D\) do
    apply standard data augmentation:
    \(\tilde{b} \leftarrow \{(\mathcal{A}(x),y) \mid (x,y) \in b\}\)
    \(\{S_k\}_{k=1}^N, Q \leftarrow \tilde{b}\)
    compute self-supervised loss:
    \(\mathcal{L}_{SSL} \leftarrow 0\)
    for \(x_i\) in \(S\) do
        \(\hat{x}_i \leftarrow \mathcal{P}(x_i, n^2)\)
        \(l_{SSL}(i) \leftarrow -\log \frac{\exp(-d(f_{\theta_s}(\hat{x}_i), f_{\theta_s}(x_i)))}{\sum_{x_j \in S} \exp(-d(f_{\theta_s}(\hat{x}_i), f_{\theta_s}(x_j)))}\)
        \(\mathcal{L}_{SSL} \leftarrow \mathcal{L}_{SSL} + l_{SSL}(i)\)
    end for
    \(\mathcal{L}_{SSL} \leftarrow \frac{1}{|S|} \mathcal{L}_{SSL}\)
    compute few-shot and self-distillation loss:
    \(\mathcal{L}_{FSL}, \mathcal{L}_{SD} \leftarrow 0\)
    \(c_{k,t} \leftarrow \frac{1}{|S_k|} \sum_{(x_i, y_i) \in S_k} f_\theta(x_i)\)
    \(c_{k,s} \leftarrow \frac{1}{|S_k|} \sum_{(x_i, y_i) \in S_k} f_{\theta_s}(x_i)\)
    for \((x_i, y_i)\) in \(Q\) do
        compute few-shot loss \(\ell(x_i, y_i)\) using \(f_{\theta_s}\) and \(c_{k,s}\):
        \(\mathcal{L}_{FSL} \leftarrow \mathcal{L}_{FSL} + \ell(x_i, y_i)\)
        \(p_t \leftarrow [-d(f_\theta(x_i), c_{1,t}), ..., -d(f_\theta(x_i), c_{N,t})]\)
        \(p_s \leftarrow [-d(f_{\theta_s}(x_i), c_{1,s}), ..., -d(f_{\theta_s}(x_i), c_{N,s})]\)
        \(\mathcal{L}_{SD} \leftarrow \mathcal{L}_{SD} + KL\left(\sigma\left(\frac{p_t}{\tau}\right) \| \sigma\left(\frac{p_s}{\tau}\right)\right)\)
    end for
    \(\mathcal{L}_{FSL} \leftarrow \frac{1}{|Q|} \mathcal{L}_{FSL}\)
    \(\mathcal{L}_{SD} \leftarrow \frac{1}{|Q|} \mathcal{L}_{SD}\)
    \(\mathcal{L} \leftarrow (1 - \gamma) \cdot \mathcal{L}_{FSL} + \beta \cdot \mathcal{L}_{SSL} + \gamma \cdot \mathcal{L}_{SD}\)
    \(\theta_s \leftarrow \theta_s - \alpha\nabla_{\theta_s} \mathcal{L}\)
end for
